Both #78 and #77 are related issues which were discussed during the 3.0 milestone.

For the next release of ASVS can the reference to PCI-DSS in _Appendix D_ be:

- [ ] Refreshed for PCI-DSS v3.2.1 and;
- [ ] Aligned to L1, L2 and L3 within the _Finance and Insurance_ Row of the Table on Page 11 of the ASVS v3.0.1 release?

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/136826/50191893-0b337980-0384-11e9-9781-ddc35239a7b8.png)
